SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS avg_units_per_order FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'wholesale' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-07-01'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS total_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY substr(o.order_date,1,7) ORDER BY CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.id = r.order_item_id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE substr(o2.order_date,1,7) = substr(o.order_date,1,7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.order_id = o2.id)) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name AS name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(li.rev),0) - COALESCE(SUM(li.ref),0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT o.employee_id AS employee_id, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) AS rev, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount),0) FROM returns r WHERE r.order_item_id = oi.id) AS ref FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01') li JOIN employees e ON e.id = li.employee_id GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

WITH closed AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS h FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(h) AS a FROM closed), cust AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(h) AS avg_h FROM closed GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust, overall WHERE cust.avg_h > overall.a AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = cust.customer_id) >= 8

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS rid, r.name AS rname, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) END) AS r24, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) END) AS r25 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id=c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id=ci.region_id WHERE o.status='delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT rname, ROUND((r25 - r24) * 100.0 / r24, 2) AS growth_pct FROM rev WHERE r24 IS NOT NULL AND r24 > 0 AND r25 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r25 - r24) * 1.0 / r24 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.created_at < '2025-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01')

SELECT c.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY units DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.name AS product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS total_margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT segment FROM (SELECT c.segment AS segment, AVG(t.units) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.customer_id AS customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY o.id, o.customer_id) t JOIN customers c ON c.id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment) ORDER BY avg_units DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS rev_h2_2025, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END), 2) AS rev_h2_2024, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND NOT (o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01') GROUP BY r.id, r.name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY growth_pct ASC LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS f FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(rev.r - COALESCE(ref.f, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.employee_id LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = rev.employee_id ORDER BY (rev.r - COALESCE(ref.f, 0)) DESC LIMIT 3

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS f FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(rev.r - COALESCE(ref.f, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.eid LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.eid = rev.eid ORDER BY (rev.r - COALESCE(ref.f, 0)) DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT e.name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders, ROUND(1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*), 4) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY e.id, e.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) DESC, e.name ASC LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) END) AS r2025 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT region, ROUND((r2025 - r2024) * 100.0 / r2024, 2) AS growth_pct FROM rev WHERE r2024 IS NOT NULL AND r2024 > 0 AND r2025 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r2025 - r2024) * 1.0 / r2024 DESC LIMIT 1
